notes: This is the editable source of truth for Who? and Hangman character and place answers.
Character entries are used by both Who? and Hangman. Location entries are used by Hangman.
Hangman book answers are generated from the app’s canonical Bible book list and are not listed here.

Audit policy: Character book lists may include references to a person by alternate biblical spellings, family/tribal descendants, or a book heading; ambiguous instances require source-level review. Location references are illustrative citations, not exhaustive book lists.

Character scripture_references give selected identifying or key-event passages, not every occurrence. Location scripture_mentioned fields are preserved. Some biblical names are shared by multiple people, and disputed identifications are not assumed.
Combined entries array: type distinguishes Person from Place. IDs are unique within each type, not across the combined catalog.
